backlog.spec: Add a final-layer cosine contrastive projection between hidden states and batch labels, and optimize the loss with batch normalization on the final embeddings to tighten the clustering head.
backlog.title: Add GradKnAcc Plausibility

backlog.spec: Change optimizer to AdamW with cosine LR scheduling (WARMUP_RATIO now effective, 0.0->0.1) and reduce lr by factor 2 after warmup.
backlog.title: Switch Adam to AdamW with Cosine Decay

backlog.spec: Modify transformer layer to use Pre-norm and add deterministic dropout IDs per layer to break symmetry during training.
backlog.title: Use Pre-norm with Dropout IDs

backlog.spec: Update AdamW weights to apply per-block scaling: block_0..k get L/2 scaling, others L, reducing effective total gradients by 0.5 for first block.
backlog.title: Enable Layer-wise Fine-tuning with Modular Learning Rates

backlog.spec: Insert a small 2NN recurrent module as an auxiliary backbone that outputs pseudo-embedding logits, concatenated with the last transformer layer before the lm_head.
backlog.title: Introduce a Latent Class Backbone

backlog.spec: After the last transformer layer, reshape the embedding into a grid and apply L1 gradient to the mean pixel values of the final layer, encouraging uniformity across the grid representation.
backlog.title: Add Grated Residual Reshaping Loss

backlog.spec: Replace TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE into 8 sub-batches of width TOTAL//8, and use per-block fused softmax to reduce internal abstractions.
backlog.title: Split Batch into 8-Width Sub-blocks

backlog.spec: At mid-training, inject a small Gaussian jitter via adversarial attack to the intermediate layer outputs and backpropagate correction signals.
backlog.title: Apply Adversarial Perturbation to Intermediate States

backlog.spec: Define a dropout mask that only deactivates a subset of rows in each transformer layer's matrix, effectively sparsifying the gradients by half.
backlog.title: Use Block-Matrix Dropout across Layers

backlog.spec: Switch to mixed precision computing (fp16) for matrix multiplications, but use fp32 for the loss and optimizer steps to improve gradient stability.
backlog.title: Implement 4-Block Mixed Precision Checkpoints

backlog.spec: Add an encoder (linear projection + ReLU) to take a 2D grid embedding, apply it to the last layer, and sum it back with a scaling factor.
backlog.title: Insert a 2-NN Encoder as a Skip Connection

backlog.spec: At the end of each epoch, compute mean squared error between the last weight layer of this block and the previous epoch's mean weights; backprop this error.
backlog.title: Apply Weight Drift Checkpointing Loss

backlog.spec: Add a constraint that forces the attention vectors of the last layer to align with adjacent attention heads across layers using a cosine similarity loss.
backlog.title: Use Attention Space Initialization Loss

backlog.spec: Every n-batch, apply a small multiplicative decay to the output of the final transformer layer and recompute gradients on the decayed output.
backlog.title: Introduce Batch-wise Feature Decay

backlog.spec: Shift the learned attention masks in the last 3 layers by a fixed offset to force non-trivial cross-attention across layers.
backlog.title: Add a 3-Deep Interlayer Attention Shift

backlog.spec: Switch to a dynamic LR schedule: WARMUP_RATIO (0.0->0.1), then linear warmdown for 0.9 of time, then sharp decay for final epoch.
backlog.title: Dynamic Learning Rate Scheduling with Warmup and Decay

backlog.spec: Create two separate Adam optimizers for embeddings/lm_head and a separate AdamW for matrix parameters to allow independent tuning rates and momentum, fixing potential internal state conflicts in the single optimizer.
backlog.title: Separate Adam and Muon Optimizers with Shared Meters

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH to 4 and increase HEAD_DIM to 256 to maintain ~1024 feature dimensions per layer, testing if shallower architectures with wider attention heads generalize better on small datasets.
backlog.title: Reduce Depth to 4 with Wider Heads

backlog.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.0 and WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.9 to apply only a linear decay for 90% of steps, removing the overhead of slow warmup that may not benefit this hyper-short training horizon.
backlog.title: Linear Learning Rate Schedule without Warmup

backlog.spec: Replace the tokenizer's batch concatenation logic with round-robin shuffling (or append chunked graphs) instead of full unshuffling, preserving local word context while breaking global repetition patterns.
backlog.title: Unshuffle the Tokenizer Batch

backlog.spec: Modify the Muon step to apply mask drops only to the top-K largest magnitude weights per layer, reducing noise sensitivity at the tail while stabilizing the largest gradients.
backlog.title: Apply Per-Topk Parameter Dropout

backlog.spec: Reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**15 (32K tokens) per step and increase MICRO_BATCH_SIZE or manual accumulation steps to 16, slowing the gradient accumulation loop to allow better mixing of weights.
backlog.title: Enable Gradient Accumulation with Slower Micro-Batch Sizes

backlog.spec: Decrease ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 32, making heads more expressive but possibly allowing better generalization with fewer layers within the time budget.
backlog.title: Reduce Aspect Ratio for Shallows Attention

backlog.spec: Raise WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 1.0 to aggressively suppress noise in the low-rank updates and stabilize the matrix parameters.
backlog.title: Increase Production Weight Decay for Matrix Weights

backlog.spec: Apply dropout masks layer-by-layer independently rather than as a global step, reducing interference between dropout updates during the Muon forward step.
backlog.title: Use Multiple-Layer Dropout Masks

backlog.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC to 0.1 or 0.05 and lower MATRIX_LR to 0.001 to reduce overshooting in later training steps and prevent divergence.
backlog.title: Reduce Final LR Scaling Factor

incumbent.description: Implement a linear learning rate decay for 90% of the training budget by setting WARMUP_RATIO to 0.0 and WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.9.

memo: Incumbent mean_adjusted is 1.0686 over 3 runs. Two changes helped a lot. Slot 11 cut TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**15 (1.0779/1.0775, -0.0369). Slot 14 used linear LR decay for 90% of the budget (1.0690/1.0671/1.0698, -0.0091). Both were accepted, and both carry a tripwire flag, so check them before building on them. Slot 19, the recurrent latent MLP, scored 1.0688 (+0.0002), which is no gain. Rejected: a lower ASPECT_RATIO (1.1304), weight decay 1.0 (1.1068), and the earlier warmup-0.1 schedule (1.1381). Crashes and patch failures (slots 0, 2, 4, 8, 10, 7, 18) came from undefined names, dtype problems and SEARCH blocks that didn't match. Next: tune one hyperparameter at a time around the incumbent. Try an even smaller batch, LR values, the warmdown fraction, and weight decay between 0.2 and 1.0. Keep edits minimal and re-read the file before writing SEARCH blocks. Avoid exotic regularizers and Muon changes.
